items.title: Milton Batiste Interview, 1997-02-05
items.q: Paul fed us. Frank worked us.

ctx.x: Here comes Pat. And, uh, that was at the Dewdrop. Now, the Dewdrop, I don't know how many stories you've heard about the Dewdrop and how it, uh, was in operation. But it was run by, uh, three brothers, mainly by Frank Pannier, uh, Joe Pannier and his brother, uh, Paul. Paul. Paul. Paul. Paul fed us. Frank worked us. Oh, yeah. Because Frank ran the, uh, entertainment part of it, you see. He booked bands, and he ran the hotel, and he ran the club, you know. And, uh, in those days, uh, there were two, uh, two types…
What was, what was the difference?
